stopping_rule: One execution of the declared grid; no tuning or reruns based on performance. Smoke checks are separate.
design_note: Matched arrival streams. Same archived movement, no door dwell or physical dynamics. Distinct distance-only nearest-car baseline is a transparent reference rule, not a reproduction of an entire published system. Fixed carrying/noise levels; diagonal floor/lift combinations restrict generality. Original accessibility/stability accounting is retained only to reproduce archived code; no comfort claims or disability-instability inference is made.
